pass_condition:
mean_over_seeds(val_ce_moe) - mean_over_seeds(val_ce_more)
  >= std_over_seeds(val_ce_more)
AND mean_over_seeds(val_ce_more) < mean_over_seeds(val_ce_moe) (MoRE beats matched MoE on mean val CE by at least MoRE's cross-seed std).
status_rule: PASS if the pass_condition holds. PARTIAL if mean(val_ce_more) < mean(val_ce_moe) but the gap is smaller than std(val_ce_more). FAIL otherwise (including ties or MoE ahead on mean).
